description: Preview how the project's test cases would run on account sets. Read-only: it plans from the saved states, roles and test cases and does not run anything. Returns the floor (fewest account sets that can run every placed test), each account set's route in order with setup runs (replays that only reach a state, with no verdict) and the one-way test that forced each account set beyond the first, the groups of states, Not allowed tests that would change a supplied account, tests whose prerequisite state no test reaches, and test cases with no states yet (they run as today). Response shape: { floor, batchLength, totalRuns, setupRuns, account sets: [{ accountSetNumber, slotNumber, steps: [{ testCaseId, prerequisiteStateId, resultStateId, isSetup, heldSuppliedRoleIds }], endStateId, isUsedUp, forcedByTestCaseId }], groups: [{ groupNumber, stateIds, isTerminal }], notAllowed: [{ testCaseId, reason, suppliedRoleIds }], missingState: [{ testCaseId, prerequisiteStateId }], unplacedTestCaseIds, unrestoredSuppliedRoleIds }.

isProduction.description: True to plan for production, which runs at the floor with no extra account sets for speed (default false)

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) that owns the test states and roles

name: muggle-remote-test-chaining-plan-get
